programme.title: Hanson: Underneath Experience Tour – Night 1 (Acoustic)
programme.desc: Hanson opens their two-night Underneath Experience Tour with an intimate acoustic performance at The Belasco in Los Angeles, celebrating the 20th anniversary of their landmark 2004 album Underneath. The set blends reimagined hits and deep cuts including “Strong Enough to Break,” “Stories,” and “When You’re Gone,” along with early fan favorites like “A Song to Sing.” Between harmonies and heartfelt stories, the brothers reflect on the album’s creation, early tours, and their enduring connection with fans.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this introspective episode, Ricky Hil — rapper, designer, and son of fashion icon Tommy Hilfiger — opens up to Joel Madden about his lifelong connection to music and streetwear, his battles with addiction, and his journey toward self-understanding. Ricky reflects on his creative independence, the lessons learned from his father, and finding peace through art after years of struggle. The conversation dives deep into authenticity, identity, and the healing power of creativity.

programme.title: Coheed and Cambria: Live at Starland Ballroom
programme.desc: Coheed and Cambria performs live at Starland Ballroom, delivering standout tracks from their first two albums in a high-energy hometown concert.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Travie McCoy discusses his gradual rise in music, from humble beginnings to headlining. He shares a metaphor from his album cover and tells a story about breaking his neck riding a dirt bike.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Los Angeles rapper Lefty Gunplay joins Joel Madden for an honest conversation about manifestation, growth, and self-belief. Lefty reflects on overcoming incarceration, finding purpose through music, and representing L.A.’s Mexican community with authenticity and pride. A grounded and motivational dialogue about humility, mindset, and the discipline it takes to turn struggle into success.

programme.title: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses perform a co-headlining concert live from The Wiltern in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: De'Wayne discusses identity and growth with Joel, touching on Lenny Kravitz, arenas, and the garage.

programme.title: Mt. Joy: Live from Red Rocks Night 1
programme.desc: Mt. Joy kicks off the first of two sold-out nights at the legendary Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado. Captured live by Veeps, the set blends fan-favorite hits and new unreleased tracks in a high-energy performance that showcases the band’s signature mix of soaring vocals and indie-rock warmth. Highlights include “Lemon Tree,” “Highway Queen,” and a special collaboration on “Lake Missoula” featuring Richy Mitch & The Coal Miners. A powerful opening night that sets the tone for a weekend of unforgettable music under the stars.

programme.title: First Listen: Motel Du Cap – Live with Good Charlotte
programme.desc: Hear Good Charlotte's new album in full with exclusive stories, commentary, and fan Q&A. Your front-row seat to Motel Du Cap.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum rapper/producer G-Eazy sits down with Joel Madden to talk brotherhood, the early grind, and returning to the road after a six-year hiatus. From funny tangents (the philosophy of milkshakes) to reflective moments about not fitting in growing up, finding belonging in music, and dedicating part of his show to his late mom, Gerald shares why performing completes the art—and how a whirlwind London stop let him share the stage with his brother James. He also recalls his first runs back (including arena-scale crowds in India) and the community that’s formed around his all-black stage persona.

programme.title: Flogging Molly: Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Flogging Molly performs a St. Patrick’s Day celebration live from Las Vegas with a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Country-rock singer-songwriter HARDY joins Joel Madden to talk about bridging the worlds of rock and country, evolving from songwriter to artist, and why connecting with fans matters most. They swap stories about small-town roots, creative identity, and finding value in authenticity over fame.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Benji Madden & M. Shadows on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji Madden and Avenged Sevenfold’s M. Shadows reflect on 25 years of friendship and creativity in a candid conversation with Artist Friendly.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 1 – Acoustic Duo with Matt Nasir
programme.desc: The opening night of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim features an intimate acoustic set from Frank Turner and Matt Nasir. The performance blends heartfelt storytelling with stripped-down versions of fan favorites, including “Be More Kind,” “The Way I Tend to Be,” and a moving duet with KT Tunstall. Turner connects deeply with the audience while revisiting early songs and debuting new arrangements in this special evening of community, humor, and reflection.

programme.title: Macklemore – The BEN Tour: Live from Hollywood
programme.desc: GRAMMY® Award-winning rapper Macklemore brings The BEN Tour to a powerful close live from the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles, California. Blending his signature anthems like “Thrift Shop” and “Same Love” with new music from BEN, Macklemore celebrates authenticity, resilience, and community in an emotional finale filled with gratitude, energy, and connection.

programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los mejores pilotos de Buffalo, tanto novatos como veteranos, viajan a California para combates aéreos en aviones de combate reales.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El homenaje de Mikey al Día D, un salto en paracaídas con 20 paracaidistas, encuentra un obstáculo cuando Joe se niega a pilotar su DC-3 hasta la zona de salto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El copiloto novato Scott se enfrenta a su peor pesadilla cuando un motor Curtiss C-46 Commando y una baja niebla obligan a un aterrizaje aterrador. El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La Navidad está a la vuelta de la esquina, pero la comida y el correo cruciales de Buffalo se detienen. Una incautación del motor deja a Scott, AJ y el avión C-46, creando una reacción en cadena caótica. El crujiente mecánico Chuck debe intentar un cambio de motor con las manos desnudas en menos 30, y la presión de los clientes y compañeros de trabajo empuja al gerente de carga Kelly.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un furioso Joe lucha contra una suspensión federal que le impedirá transportar pasajeros por primera vez en 20 años. También es un revés para Jeremy y las otras rampas, que empeora con una lesión inesperada. Para el equipo de waterbomber de Turquía, finalmente es una oportunidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de la amarga partida de su esposo de Buffalo, Kelly tiene una confrontación que decide si ella también renunciará. Jeremy comete un error que podría terminar con su carrera en Buffalo. La escasez de gasolina de aviación trae una dosis de realidad aleccionadora a los McBryans. Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Todo Esta Bien Si Termina Bien
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La producción teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario héroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una hermosa princesa resulta transformada en una bruja y necesita los bigotes de un gato y la lágrima de un Pitufo para preparar una poción mágica. Azrael, Pitufo Gruñón y Pitufo Bromista se convierten en colaboradores involuntarios y, cuando se produce la transformación mágica, la princesa les libera y regresan felices a su hogar.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Pitufos Leñadores
programme.desc: Un grupo de codiciosos leñadores planea talar el bosque del rey Gerard mientras se encuentra de vacaciones lejos de allí. Papá Pitufo disfraza a los Pitufos de fantasmas para espantar a los leñadores, que se rinden voluntariamente ante el rey cuando este regresa con su séquito.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Choza No Es Un Hogar
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza más grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del revés y esto le convence de que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Hay Que Atrapar Al Ladrón
programme.desc: Los Pitufos y Ómnibus se hacen amigos de un desdichado joven cuyo maestro le obliga a robar. Pronto, el malvado ladrón es entregado al magistrado y el joven está encantado de irse a vivir con Ómnibus.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan ocupados demostrando su propia fuerza de voluntad que no se dan cuenta de que Gargamel ha capturado a Pitufo Armonía. Papá Pitufo ofrece a Gargamel una caja con trampa para poner a prueba su fuerza de voluntad, lo que permite escapar a Pitufo Armonía.

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la superstición cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Goloso Y La Olla De Estofado
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: El Mejor Amigo De Vanidoso
programme.desc: Para Pitufo Vanidoso, no hay ningún espectáculo más fabuloso ni nada más satisfactorio que contemplarse a sí mismo. Cuando se topa con un diablillo adulador, está seguro de que ha encontrado a su mejor amigo para toda la vida. Pero las cosas no siempre son tan sencillas, ya que los amigos pueden meterte en problemas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los días la misma rutina, las mismas tareas, la misma vida… Pitufina está aburrida de todo eso. ¿No sería mucho más divertida una travesía en barco por alta mar? Y resulta que Pitufo Soñador está planeando un crucero. ¿Acaso no suena como el mismísimo paraíso?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Robotín se sobrecalienta tras el impacto de un rayo. Papá Pitufo tiene que apresurarse para enfriarlo antes de que se queme. Aun así, Pitufo Robotín utiliza su último voltio de energía para salvar a los Pitufos de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Gorjeos De Smoogle
programme.desc: Clorhidris planea transformar la primavera en la estación más infeliz del año. Atrapa el Azulejo de la Felicidad y lo transforma en un estruendoso cuervo. Cualquiera que oiga el canto del Cuervo de la Infelicidad se volverá infeliz. Solo Gruñón puede salvar la primavera.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer…

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Sonámbulos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel está seguro de que ha encontrado la solución definitiva al fastidioso asunto de los Pitufos. Su flauta mágica convertirá sus tranquilos sueños en pesadillas…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Busqueda De La Piedra Magica
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar cuando Gargamel consigue que su libro de hechizos conjure un nuevo lugar más hermoso para que los Pitufos vivan en él: ¡un lugar perfecto para que pueda tenderles una trampa!

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer…

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Sonámbulos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel está seguro de que ha encontrado la solución definitiva al fastidioso asunto de los Pitufos. Su flauta mágica convertirá sus tranquilos sueños en pesadillas…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. programme.title: Coming to America

programme.title: Kill Zone

programme.title: Flash Point

programme.title: Major League

programme.title: Only Lovers Left Alive

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army…and each other!

programme.title: Gunfight At The O.K. Corral
programme.desc: Frontier lawman Wyatt Earp joins his three brothers in their feud against the villainous Clanton gang, a local clan of cattle thieves in Tombstone, Arizona.

programme.title: Spy Kids
programme.desc: Super-spies Gregorio (Antonio Banderas) and Ingrid (Carla Gugino) give up their lives of intrigue to raise their children. After a sinister super-villain kidnaps the parents, it's up to the kids to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Spy Kids 2: The Island of Lost Dreams
programme.desc: In the sequel, the OSS now has a full child-spy section and our hero siblings Carmen and Juni Cortez have become agents. On a mission to recover a dangerous device that threatens the entire world, they enlist the skills of their family.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

programme.title: Steel Dawn
programme.desc: A nomad warrior must help save a beautiful woman and her young son from a band of henchmen stalking them through the desert after a nuclear war.

programme.title: Popeye
programme.desc: The legendary, beloved anvil-armed sailor of the seven seas comes magically to life in this delightful musical, starring Robin Williams as Popeye, who meets all challenges with the unshakable philosophy, "I yam what I yam and that's all that I yam."

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: X (2022)
programme.desc: A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

programme.title: Pearl: An X-traordinary Origin Story
programme.desc: Trapped on her family's isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter, overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in the movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life, until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: A blaxploitation film about a woman whose drug-dealing brother ratted on her undercover narcotics-agent boyfriend to the mob and she, in turn, poses as a call girl to infiltrate the mobsters who butchered him.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers

programme.title: A Simple Favor

programme.title: American Ultra

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: Single girl Bridget Jones decides to turn over a new page in her life, channeling her thoughts, opinions, and insecurities into a diary. It's instead a hilarious chronicle of her adventures in this modern-romance classic based on the bestseller.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Star Trek

programme.title: Total Recall

programme.title: Rocky V

programme.title: Rocky Balboa

programme.title: Brad Bonar
programme.sub-title: The Comedy and Magic of Brad Bonar
programme.desc: Brad is a double threat. One of the most talented magicians in the country, he is also a very gifted and funny stand-up comedian. His wealth of material springs from his observations of family life, (Brad has four children). Brad's comedy is universal in its appeal, and along with the magic displayed in his show, he has become a favorite at every event he goes to. His magic shows the devious side of magician's life, messing with everyday people as they go about their business and giving them stories to tell for the rest of their lives. Brad also owns and operates Bonar Entertainment Group, a successful production company in Northern California. As an entertainer, Brad's job is to make as many friends as possible in a short amount of time. As a motivational speaker, he talks about the skills he has acquired over the years on how to make superficial friends and also on how to move beyond these types of friendships into deeper levels of trust and sharing with the people that we associate with on a daily basis. With more than 10 years of experience working with such clients as Bank of America, Coldwell Banker, Cope & McPhetres Marine, Evian Water, Hewlett Packard, MCI and many others, Brad Bonar offers a wide variety of services to enhance any entertainment event. Whether you need stand-up comedy, close-up magic, motivational speaking, a Master of Ceremonies or a corporate spokesperson, Brad's insight into what really makes an event entertaining and memorable is sure to have an impact on your audience.

programme.title: Tommy Ryman
programme.desc: Tommy Ryman grew up with a new-age, folk singing mother and a traditional, Lutheran insurance-agent father. This XY equation evidently equals: acclaimed comedian. Ryman has earned the title of Semifinalist on NBC's Last Comic Standing. Roseanne Barr, a professed fan, raves she has “never seen anything like Tommy before in her whole life, he is one-of-a-kind, fantastic!” Ryman also recently won the title of Best of the Midwest at the prestigious Gilda's Laugh Fest. Ryman's act can be described as absurdist and clever, masked behind a very likable and innocent demeanor, often thought of as awkwardly charming. He is a favorite among audiences at top clubs, corporates, and colleges around the nation.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner
programme.sub-title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg & Jimmy J¢rgensen
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures! It will be fun, touching, crazy and dramatic when the Concert Hall is filled with living lines drawn in tones in the big room. The DR Symphony Orchestra, DR Big Band and DR Vocal Ensemble have joined forces to take you to a party in the cartoon universes.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Deep Purple
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. Here, the orchestral arrangements give an added depth and range to the familiar songs. The band responds to both playing with the orchestra and performing in such a historical location to deliver a brilliant show in front of a huge and enthusiastic crowd.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Featuring the classic Foreigner line-up of Jones, Gramm, McDonald, Greenwood, Gagliardi and Elliott, this show captures the essence of a group who would go on to become one of the best-selling bands of all time. On April 27 1978, after their self-titled debut album had spent a year in the US Top 20, rock's conquering heroes played a sold-out show at London's legendary music venue, the Rainbow Theatre. Opening with 'Long, Long Way From Home', the band's legion of fans were treated to a magnificent display of musicianship and performance, including local hit singles, 'Feels Like The First Time' and 'Cold As Ice', as well as an exclusive preview of two tracks from the upcoming ‘Double Vision' album. Forty years on, this definitive performance by the original band has been restored from the original film reels, remixed and remastered for this release.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: A special compilation episode looking back at the best Chew It or Screw It moments from the past six months, featuring some of the show's most memorable guests playing along as the hosts ask them to weigh in on food, lifestyle, and totally random preferences. Segments include: Danielle Sepsy (the Scone Queen) forced to choose between scones and muffins—predictably choosing scones—plus her takes on stuffing vs. mashed potatoes and canned vs. homemade cranberry sauce; Liz Symon (Michael's wife) on orange wine, foofy cocktails, lazy sundaes, the New York Times Spelling Bee app (Queen Bee 99% of the time), stinky cheese, and the truth about cuddling with Michael; Marysol Castro on Citi Field hot dogs, pineapple on pizza (a hard Bronx no), and celebrity cameos at sporting events (the exception being Bad Bunny); Amanda Freitag and the crew on going out to eat on Valentine's Day (screw it—you get the worst service and cooks who rarely go out); Devyn Simone on cooking for someone on a first date (surprisingly chew it, as long as boundaries are established) and not texting the next day after getting lucky; Esther Choi on breakfast for dinner, ketchup on eggs (a unanimous screw it from the entire panel); Scott Conant on sending food back at a restaurant (screw it—you're an adult, figure it out), family style with strangers (chew it), and splitting the check 12 ways; Damaris Phillips on cornbread with sugar, Miracle Whip with bologna, and the boat-ride romance that made her appreciate Miracle Whip on a sandwich; Maneet Chauhan on spicy desserts, taking the last bite when sharing a dish (chew it if you're single and looking for a partner), and eating off someone else's plate; Mika Leon on the five-second rule, helicopter parenting, staying up 24 hours to cook (chew it—she did 32-plus hours on a cooking competition), and going to the club (hard pass, she's tired); and Chef Jackie Bula on air fryers (screw it—just fry), and reality cooking competitions (screw it—it's less about the food than the show). Audience engagement prompts woven throughout invite viewers to comment on their own chew-it-or-screw-it takes.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Chewed Up Compilation #2: BLOOPERS showcases the funniest and most unexpected moments from season four. Clinton accidentally consumes a THC-infused beverage before reading fan mail, Michael passionately debates whether air fryers are just convection ovens and defends wood cutting boards, and Carla reveals her unconventional Christmas card habits. The episode features heated discussions about bagel varieties, seed oils, Instagram fitness culture, and holiday movie preferences. The climax occurs during a butter cookie demonstration when a frozen egg yolk refuses to incorporate and a pastry bag catastrophically fails on camera, turning an otherwise polished cooking segment into comedic chaos.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The Chewed Up crew sets up poolside at the W Hotel South Beach for a breezy St. Patrick's Day episode that swaps corned beef for Cuban grilled shrimp. Michael Symon, whose Cleveland neighborhood is deeply Irish, admits he's been celebrating St. Patrick's Day with his best friend Jimmy for decades, and this year Jimmy joins them in Miami. Michael's Grilled Shrimp Mojo is a tribute to the Cuban flavors of Miami: shrimp marinated in lime zest, lime juice, chili flakes, and olive oil, then grilled and finished with a vibrant mojo sauce blended from sour orange, onion, a whole head of garlic, cilantro, parsley, and oregano. The key tip: cook shrimp until they look like commas, not O'sóthe moment they curl completely is the moment they're overdone. Clinton reflects on his seven years living in Miami and the city's culinary depth, from Cuban staples to modern restaurants like Yardbird. Carla raises her fear of sharks; Clinton counters with his inexplicable terror of birds getting caught in his hair. Michael confesses he bought a bathing suit specifically to go to the beach, put it on, saw himself in the mirror, and decided to spend the afternoon in bed instead.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Just in time for National Ravioli Day, acclaimed chef and Chopped judge Scott Conant joins the trio at the W South Beach to make his delicate ricotta gnocchiótechnically gnudióalongside his signature Martone Street jarred tomato sauce. Michael has been close friends with Scott for 15 years, and Clinton admits he was genuinely nervous before meeting the notoriously stern Chopped judge, quickly discovering he's warm and funny in person. Scott explains that Martone Street is named for his grandparents' home in Waterbury, Connecticut, where Sunday dinners taught him that conversation over food is one of life's greatest gifts. The gnocchi dough combines fresh ricotta, basil, breadcrumbs, flour, egg, and Parmesan, shaped into small dumplings and cooked until they float. Scott builds a stabilized butter sauce using pasta water and cornstarch as an emulsifieróa trick that keeps it smooth for hours. Finished with Martone Street sauce and broccoli rabe, the result is stunning in its simplicity. His philosophy runs throughout: spaghetti aglio e olio, done correctly, is one of the most complex and satisfying dishes imaginable. Scott becomes emotional talking about watching his 16-year-old daughter drive for the first time and the joy of steak cook-offs with his girls at home.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon dive into an episode celebrating coffee and food pairing. The hosts prepare two standout recipes: a homemade Cinnamon Coffee Cake perfect for breakfast or dessert, and an authentic Buena Vista–Style Irish Coffee that brings San Francisco cafe tradition into home kitchens. Viewers get insider tips and techniques from three seasoned culinary professionals.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Two-time Tournament of Champions winner and Chopped veteran Maneet Chauhan arrives at the W South Beach as a true Queen of Flavor, demonstrating her Indian Spiced Ceviche, a dish that applies Indian culinary logic to coastal Latin technique. Fresh fish is cured in lime juice in the traditional ceviche manner, then transformed with coconut milk to soften the heat and balance the citrus, and finished with a tarka: the Indian technique of blooming whole spices in searing hot coconut oil and pouring it directly over the dish at the last second. The result is layered, bright, and unexpected. Maneet explains that she grew up in a small town in India and learned to cook by exploring her neighbors' kitchens, each representing a different regional tradition. She recounts a pivotal story from Peru, where she made potato pancakes alongside a local woman without sharing a single word of common languageóconnected entirely through food and gesture. That philosophy runs through her Nashville restaurant, which introduces diners to bold Indian flavors through fusion dishes like hot chicken korma and chicken tikka salad poutine. She draws a parallel between the tarka and the French beurre blancóboth finishing techniques that transform a dish in the final seconds of cooking. Michael, Clinton, and Carla taste the ceviche with genuine surprise and awe.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: As the Chewed Up crew wraps up their week at the W South Beach, Miami-born chef Mika Leon brings the most authentically local dish of the entire trip: Pan Con Lechon, the slow-roasted Cuban pork sandwich that anchors Noche Buena, Cuban Christmas Eve. Mika woke up at 4 AM to start the pork shoulderómarinated overnight in a mojo sauce built on sour orange juice, lime juice, orange juice, and 50 cloves of garlic from her grandfather's recipe. After six hours at 350 degrees, the pork is shredded and crisped with additional mojo in a hot pan, then piled high on a special Cuban rollósweeter and fattier than regular bread, made with lard throughout. Mika shares her journey from dabbling in TV production (she quit after a week) to opening a food truck selling $5 Pan Con Lechons at 3 AM to Miami club-goers, which grew into a full restaurant and now a cookbook. Carla notes that the best cooks often learn from family before any formal training, and this dish proves it. The group discusses Miami's cultural identityómore its own country than a Florida cityódefined by Spanglish, its own traffic logic, and immigrant food traditions passed down for generations. Clinton finally admits that despite a full week at the W, none of them ever made it into the pool.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The South Beach week closes with a live audience tapingóthe most unhinged episode of the tripóas Michael Symon, Carla Hall, and Clinton Kelly perform in front of a crowd of fans. Michael's voice is noticeably shot from a long week of celebrating, so Clinton and Carla carry extra energy while he freestyle hosts from notes he promptly loses within 30 seconds. Carla makes her refreshing Pineapple Lime Agua Fresca: blended fresh pineapple with lime water (lime juice diluted to avoid sharpness), ginger, honey, and wateróa batched mocktail or cocktail mixer that's as beautiful as it is easy. She shares her tip for getting full use of citrus by zesting before juicing. The episode features 'Chew It or Screw It,' a voting game where the audience weighs in on Florida's most adventurous foods: iguana pizza, python sausage, alligator ribs, conch fritters, and fried frog legs. Carla and Clinton report on their spontaneous 7 AM sunrise bike rideótheir first ever togetheróand Clinton jokes about his impossibly pale, non-tanning legs. The trio explores Florida's wildlife peculiarities, from iguanas falling from trees in cold snaps to flying cockroaches given affectionate nicknames. A Chewed Up Challenge heads-up guessing game rounds out the audience interaction with giveaways. Season 3's Miami week ends exactly how it began: loud, funny, and hungry.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this “Munch Madness” episode of Chewed Up, Carla Hall, Clinton Kelly, and Michael Symon put eight frozen pizzas through a bracket-style taste test inspired by March Madness. The hosts compare each pairing, breaking down crust, sauce, cheese, and overall flavor while mixing in humor, nostalgia, and brutally honest reactions. As they move through the rounds, the conversation is fueled by strong opinions, unexpected preferences, and plenty of debate about what actually makes a good pizza. Michael’s love of authentic pizza drives passionate critiques, Clinton reflects on his long hiatus from frozen options, and Carla keeps things grounded in everyday practicality for busy households. The competition builds toward a final showdown that sparks lively discussion and a few surprising takes. The episode then shifts into a conversation about potlucks, outdoor dining, and picnics, blending personal preferences with playful arguments. It wraps with a fan giveaway and the hosts’ signature banter.

programme.title: War Journal: The Incredible World War II Escape of Major Damon Rocky Gause
programme.desc: The thrilling true story of a nearly impossible escape from prison camp during World War II. In 1942, American airman Rocky Gause escaped a prison camp on the Bataan Peninsula, swam to nearby Corregidor Island, and then sailed with U.S. serviceman William Osborne in a leaky fishing boat 3,200 miles from the Philippines to Australia. Despite facing typhoons, constant threats from Japanese ships, submarines and airplanes, a lack of water and food, and even a visit to the worlds largest leper colony, both men survived to recount their harrowing 52-day ordeal. Filmed in Bataan, Corregidor, and in Manila, the documentary features the journals of Gause and Osborne, archival footage and photos, and interviews with relatives and Army associates. It is narrated by three-time Emmy Award-winning actor Chandler Massey, and actor Kyle Chandler (Argo, Zero Dark Thirty and Carol) provides the voice of Rocky.

programme.title: Swimming in Auschwitz
programme.desc: A gripping documentary, SWIMMING IN AUSCHWITZ sheds light on the Holocaust experience from the rarely explored perspective of six women imprisoned inside the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp. The intertwined stories of survivors Eva Beckmann, Rena Drexler, Renee Firestone, Erika Jacoby, Lili Majzner and Linda Sherman illustrate their individual, yet universal, Holocaust experiences.The womens lives slowly morphed into a never-ending saga of persecution and ghettoization. Starting in 1942, Nazis herded Jewish women from Poland, Czechoslovakia, Hungary and Holland onto cattle cars and transported them through the gates of Auschwitz-Birkenau. Separated from family after three or more days on a train with no food or water, stripped of their clothes, their heads shaved and their arms tattooed, they often spent the first night outdoors with the smell of the crematoria in the air.In the ensuing months, their survival within the camp depended largely on luck, yet the six women just teenagers at the time found ways to keep their hope alive. The prisoners maintained a spiritual resistance through prayer, community, music and even humor. Through surprising anecdotes, these women reveal the unlikely role laughter played in their survival. The film's title derives from its most powerful story. Marching through the camp on a particularly hot August day, the group passed by a swimming pool kept for Nazi officers. For one of the women, this sight was just too tempting. To the shock of the rest of the group, she jumped in the pool and swam from one end to the other.The compelling testimonials in this film demonstrate the Nazis' failure to crush the will of Jews. The women profiled do not dwell on the physical and emotional hardships; instead, they speak of camp families and faith, and the ways in which they tried to uplift one another and retain their humanity. Their stories reveal the power of laughter and community, even in the face of unimaginable evil.

programme.title: The Portillo Expedition: Mystery on the Bougainville Island
programme.desc: THE PORTILLO EXPEDITION: MYSTERY ON BOUGAINVILLE ISLAND examines the circumstances surrounding the death of Isoroku Yamamoto the Japanese WWII Admiral who planned the Pearl Harbor surprise attack and the Battle at Midway. Admiral Yamamotos plane, the Betty Bomber, was shot down by American P-38 fighter planes in 1943. Narrated by Gary Sinise, the documentary follows a crew of American explorers to the remote jungle of the western Solomon Islands, where they search for the wreck of the Betty Bomber sparking a further quest to understand what they find there.

programme.title: D-Day: The Price of Freedom
programme.desc: Five D-Day veterans return to Normandy and re-visit the locations they landed on June 6, 1944, sharing their own very personal stories of war.

programme.title: Navy Heroes of Normandy
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, more than 52,000 American sailors on board thousands of U.S. Navy ships arrived off a quiet stretch of coast in Normandy, France, setting in motion he largest amphibious and landing assault of World War II. Their mission, Operation Neptune-Overlord, would prove critical to the success of the Allied invasion of Western Europe. Despite the casualties of D-Day 1,068 Americans died in the initial assault on Hitler's fortressed coastline no monument stood to honor their sacrifices. NAVY HEROES OF NORMANDY chronicles the building and dedication of the first-ever U.S. Navy monument in Normandy. In an emotional climax, a large gathering of dignitaries, French citizens and D-Day veterans witness the installation and dedication of the 12-foot-tall bronze sculpture on France's Utah Beach, a long-overdue official recognition for the crucial role they played on that fateful day.

programme.title: Remember Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: The focus of this film is on the military and civilian survivors of Pearl Harbor, all of whom had totally different experiences onDecember 7, 1941.

programme.title: The U-Boat and the Rocket
programme.desc: During World War II, the Germans had two deadly weapons in their arsenal the U-Boat and the V-2 rocket. The new documentary film THE U-BOAT AND THE ROCKET chronicles the wartime development of the V-2, which was the worlds first long-range guided ballistic missile, and Germanys attempts to deploy the weapon from its formidable U-Boats. Woven into this history is the tale of two German brothers who were each involved with the secretive mission for the Third Reich. Ernst Steinhoff was Wernher von Brauns assistant for guidance control on the V-2, and Friedrich Steinhoff was a U-boat captain-lieutenant. Rich with archival footage and interviews with historical experts, THE U-BOAT AND THE ROCKET recounts Germany's creation and testing of the rocket, and the story of the two brothers who ultimately met different fates at the end of the war. Ernst and Wernher von Braun were invited to come to the U.S. in Operation Paperclip, the secret United States intelligence program which employed German scientists after Germany surrendered. Both Ernst and von Braun were subsequently inaugurated in the International Space Hall of Fame as pioneers of the Space Age. For Friedrich, the outcome was very different. After surrendering his U-Boat, he was brutally interrogated by US naval agents and allegedly committed suicide in a New England prison.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When it comes to fishing and the marine industry, we are often more united by the Bluefin tuna than we think. For Ali Hussainy, the Bluefin is responsible for fueling his life long passion as an angler, and in this episode he gets to share that passion with two friends that have their own ties to the species. For wildlife biologist Forrest Galante and master sushi chef Hiroyuki Terada, catching a bluefin tuna on rod and reel will be a first!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Local Knowledge crew heads to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California to participate in the 2024 War Heroes On Water tournament. This event offers a unique opportunity for the sport fishing community to create meaningful connections with our nation's heroes while raising awareness of the challenges they sometimes face when transitioning back to civilian life. With a little bit of luck and a lot of teamwork, Ali and Rush hope to put their veterans on a Bluefin tuna bite they won't forget!

programme.title: Local Knowledge

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: HUnting Land Man

programme.desc: Captain Scott Walker heads swordfishing out of Hawks Cay with his friend, retired WWE wrestler Travis Tomko.

programme.title: Life On The Water
programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Ariel Medero fish with David Moss from the Nature Conservancy out of Hawks Cay sampling the bottom fishing and deep dropping. In between the action they learn about the Nature Conservancy’s mission to promote sustainable and transparent fishing practices.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger break in Plantation Boat Mart’s new 36’ Invincible with some muttons for dinner and an epic shallow water sailfish double.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA Tracker was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell.

programme.title: Sail Kings
